data.comment:
# Comfy Single Image to Multiple Consistent Shots

Upload an input image and automatically generate X prompts for camera angle and shot type. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/templates-multiple_consistent_shots-nb_pro.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.

data.prompt:
Generate 6 different prompts following the instructions below. 
Each prompt idea needs to be 50-80 words max and be separated by *.
Each prompt should be unique, varying the camera angles and shot type. Add subtle detail and maintain consistent elements.
